nina (eng-runtime): quick heads-up: during the weekly vuln sweep we found two fixes in libssl and libc that we should push into a rebuilt base image. artifacts are built but unsigned. proposing HSM-backed signing + strict RBAC for the promotion flow.

arjun (eng-security): thanks. couple of asks up-front: (1) we need attestations that carry SBOM hash + git SHA + changelog link, (2) audit logs tied to the KMS key id and preserved for 13 months, (3) only infra-builds SA + 2 approvers can sign/promote.

maria (eng-infra): we can provision an HSM-backed CMK (AWS CloudHSM via KMS) under alias/rebuild-3967-hsm. granting kms:Sign & kms:GetPublicKey to infra-builds is fine. rotation window is next maintenance but this key will be created with key policy limiting principals. ETA ~40m.

kevin (oncall): rollout plan suggestion: staging-canary 5% (1h) -> 25% (3h) -> 100% (24h) with metric gates (crashloop, imagepull, latency). who owns canary monitoring?

nina (eng-runtime): i'll own canary metrics (p99 latency, startup failures). arjun you own SIEM/security signals. maria you own key lifecycle and RBAC changes. kevin you'll coordinate escalation.

arjun (eng-security): for audit retention, SIEM currently keeps 90d. maria please open a ticket to extend CloudTrail event export & S3 retention to 13 months for attestations and KMS events. also require CloudTrail logValidation turned on for the bucket.

maria (eng-infra): will do. quick IAM snippet to attach to infra-builds role:

```
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name infra-builds --policy-name HsmCosignPolicy --policy-document '{\n  "Version":"2012-10-17",\n  "Statement":[{\n    "Effect":"Allow",\n    "Action":["kms:Sign","kms:GetPublicKey","kms:DescribeKey"],\n    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_3967_HSM"\n  }]\n}'
```

arjun (eng-security): add a condition to the policy that signing can only be called from our CI IPs or from the EKS cluster role to reduce blast radius. also add a separate auditable approval step in the pipeline (2-person approval).

nina (eng-runtime): CI changes (high-level): cosign sign and attest steps, upload SBOM and attestations to S3, emit CloudTrail event, and include metadata. example pipeline snippet:

```
- run: cosign sign --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3967-hsm registry.redwood/base:sha
- run: cosign attest --predicate sbom.json --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3967-hsm registry.redwood/base:sha
- run: aws s3 cp sbom.json s3://redwood-attestations/base/3967773333/sbom.json
- run: aws s3 cp attestations.json s3://redwood-attestations/base/3967773333/attestations.json
```

attest-bot: artifact uploaded: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base/3967773333 (unsigned)

maria (eng-infra): kubernetes RBAC: we should create a RoleBinding so the build-controller can read attestation objects in `attest` ns, but keep the promotion job in `ci` ns limited. snippet:

```
kubectl create rolebinding build-controller-attest-reader -n attest --role=attest-reader --serviceaccount=infra:build-controller
kubectl create rolebinding ci-promotion-trigger -n ci --role=promotion-invoker --serviceaccount=infra:promotion-sa
```

arjun (eng-security): also require that attestations include the KMS key ARN and the signing principal (IAM role or user) as part of predicate. That makes post-incident forensics easier.

neena (eng-runtime): minor note: cosign supports keyless and kms URIs. confirm we use ksm:// or kms:// style, and whether cosign can emit the key ARN in the attestation.

maria (eng-infra): we'll use the kms://awsarn format the pipeline supports. cosign will include the keyID in signature metadata; we'll also inject signed predicate fields with git_sha and changelog_url.

kevin (oncall): rollback playbook? if we see increased crashes or image-pull errors, plan is: 1) set router weight back to previous image, 2) revoke promotion tag, 3) notify customers if any impacts. who triggers rollback?

nina (eng-runtime): i'll trigger immediate rollback and post a runbook link. kevin escalate to oncall if metrics exceed thresholds. keep both old and new images signed so there is always traceability.

arjun (eng-security): compliance check: mark this as a high-provenance release and file a short runbook addendum for the audit team. include SBOM diffs and test evidence.

maria (eng-infra): created key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_3967_HSM. applied policy and created rolebindings. opened ticket #INFRA-4521 to extend CloudTrail/S3 retention to 13 months and enable log validation.

attest-bot: signing queue ready. awaiting 2 approvals in CI.

nina (eng-runtime): requesting approvals now. please +1 in CI if you are an approver. starting 5% canary once signed. will post metrics in ~15m. :eyes:

arjun (eng-security): approving in CI. double-check SBOM contains SPDX identifiers and package hashes.

kevin (oncall): standing by for metrics. set pager escalation to include SRE and security if crashloop > 0.5% for 5m.
